description.value: You mix your resin with other chemicals to make yourself repellent to specific attackers. When you select this feat, choose one trait from among animal, beast, celestial, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, fungus, giant, ooze, plant, spirit, undead, or any ancestry trait, such as human or ysoki. Any creature with that trait that starts its turn within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of you or attacks you with a jaws attack must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:sickened] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all foul fragrance auras for 24 hours. You can change which trait you choose by spending 1 day of downtime adjusting your internal chemistry.
